title: oOZelephOo's Modpack
description: A Vanilla+ enhancement pack focused on massive exploration, featuring over 1,300 custom advancements to unlock and complete!
body:
Welcome to my modpack! I originally created this pack just for myself to play in singleplayer, but I think it turned out really cool, so I wanted to share it with everyone. It includes some of my favorite mods to improve the game while keeping it fun, beautiful, and simple.

### 🌟 Key Features

* **The Ultimate Vanilla+ Experience:** Designed to enhance the core gameplay of Minecraft 1.21.1 without losing its original charm.
* **The Completionist's Dream:** Includes the famous *BlazeandCave's Advancements Pack*, adding **over 1,300 custom advancements** to unlock and complete! And more than 3,000 others.
* **Infinite Exploration:** Discover overhauled landscapes, brand-new structures, and breathtaking terrain generation.

---

### 📦 What's Inside?

* **Epic Dimensions & Exploration:** Delve into the deep dark horrors with *Deeper and Darker*. Explore a completely reimagined world thanks to *Terralith*, *Tectonic*, and *YUNG's Better Series*.
* **Cozy & Immersive World:** Watch the world change around you with *Fabric Seasons*, upgrade your farming and cooking game with *Farmer's Delight* (along with its expansions like *End's Delight*), and build the perfect base using *Beautify* and *Macaw's Bridges*.
* **Enhanced Visuals & Performance:** Enjoy incredibly smooth gameplay with *Sodium*, *Lithium*, and *Indium*, alongside stunning pre-configured graphics powered by *Complementary Reimagined* shaders.
* **Quality of Life:** Adventure with ease using *JEI*, *Jade*, *Xaero's Minimap*, and *Xaero's World Map*.

I hope you enjoy playing it as much as I do!
